#2922 -- source evidence for the fix
=====================================

  c0676c7ca1033a0e5c7a0b19caac6c42889b5b27

  2022-04-05 12:07:07 -0700
  Handling dbg.value pointer case in O1. (#4375)

$ git show --stat=200 --format='' c0676c7ca
   include/dxc/DXIL/DxilUtil.h                           |   3 +
   lib/DxilPIXPasses/DxilAnnotateWithVirtualRegister.cpp |   3 +-
   lib/DxilPIXPasses/DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare.cpp        | 125 +++++++++++++++++-------------
   tools/clang/unittests/HLSL/PixTest.cpp                | 573 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++--------------------------
   4 files changed, 546 insertions(+), 158 deletions(-)

  Two PIX passes, one inline helper in a header, and the tests. Nothing in the
  code path dxc.exe runs to produce DXIL -- which is why dxc's own output, and
  therefore cmd.txt and any Compiler Explorer link, cannot show this fix.

Which shipped releases contain it? This is what pins the fix inside the measured
v1.6.2112 -> v1.7.2207 window rather than merely near it.

  $ git merge-base --is-ancestor c0676c7ca v1.6.2104   ->  exit 1: predates the fix
  $ git merge-base --is-ancestor c0676c7ca v1.6.2106   ->  exit 1: predates the fix
  $ git merge-base --is-ancestor c0676c7ca v1.6.2112   ->  exit 1: predates the fix
  $ git merge-base --is-ancestor c0676c7ca v1.7.2207   ->  exit 0: contains the fix

$ git log --oneline v1.6.2112..v1.7.2207 | wc -l        (size of the window)
  248

$ git log --oneline v1.6.2112..v1.7.2207 -- lib/DxilPIXPasses/DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare.cpp
  c0676c7ca Handling dbg.value pointer case in O1. (#4375)
  7f7278b4e PIX: avoid crash on enumerated types without int base type (#4254)
  b71cfcb07 PIX: ensure allocas generated by value-to-declare dominate uses (#4145)

$ git show -U6 c0676c7ca -- lib/DxilPIXPasses/DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare.cpp
  (the handleDbgValue hunk -- the whole defect and the whole fix)
  @@ -646,24 +662,35 @@ void DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare::handleDbgValue(
     if (V == nullptr) {
       // The metadata contained a null Value, so we ignore it. This
       // seems to be a dxcompiler bug.
       VALUE_TO_DECLARE_LOG("...Null value!");
       return;
     }
  -
  -  if (auto *PtrTy = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::PointerType>(V->getType())) {
  -    VALUE_TO_DECLARE_LOG("... variable had null pointer type");
  -    return;
  -  }
  
     const llvm::DITypeIdentifierMap EmptyMap;
     llvm::DIType *Ty = Variable->getType().resolve(EmptyMap);
     if (Ty == nullptr) {
       return;
     }
  
  +  if (llvm::isa<llvm::PointerType>(V->getType())) {
  +    // Safeguard: If the type is not a pointer type, then this is
  +    // dbg.value directly pointing to a memory location instead of
  +    // a value.
  +    if (!IsDITypePointer(Ty, EmptyMap)) {
  +      // We only know how to handle AllocaInsts for now
  +      if (!isa<AllocaInst>(V)) {
  +        VALUE_TO_DECLARE_LOG("... variable had pointer type, but is not an alloca.");
  +        return;
  +      }
  +
  +      IRBuilder<> B(DbgValue->getNextNode());

The B.CreateLoad(V) this adds is directly visible in the measured output:
manual-case-release-history.txt shows main's post-pass @main containing
  %4 = load %struct.smallPayload.0, %struct.smallPayload.0* %p1
which v1.6.2112's post-pass @main does not have. That is the fix executing.

When were the -O1 test opt-outs added and removed?

$ git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -S "don't run -O1 test until pointer types are dealt with" -- tools/clang/unittests/HLSL/PixTest.cpp
  c0676c7ca 2022-04-05 Handling dbg.value pointer case in O1. (#4375)
  265492784 2020-12-01 PIX: Update debugging passes for certain language features (#3289)

  Added 2020-12-01, six months AFTER this issue was filed (2020-05-27), and
  removed by the fix on 2022-04-05. Between those dates the suite was
  deliberately not testing what #2922 reports.
